note: Three field-level differences found by reading the official OpenAI Chat encoder. Each case is bracketed by a control, so only "control passes, case passes, control passes" counts as evidence.

question.A-tools-absent: The official encoder omits the tools field entirely when a request declares none. This bridge instead sends a read placeholder.
question.B-small-max-tokens: This bridge raises a caller budget below minOutputTokens (32000) to that floor. Does the gateway accept a smaller value?
question.C-system-as-user: The official encoder renders a system-role message inside messages as a user message.

conclusion.tools absent: REFUSED. The placeholder declaration is required; the plugin is already correct. The official client does omit the field for its stateless title call, but a failed title is silent, so those refusals go unnoticed.
conclusion.small max_completion_tokens: ACCEPTED. The gateway does not require the 32000 floor. The floor remains a documented configuration choice rather than a requirement.
conclusion.system rendered as user: ACCEPTED by the gateway, but not adopted: the only system message DSH sends is the system prompt itself, so converting it would strip the model of its instructions.
